title: Illustrative: central bank raises policy repo rate by 25 bps
summary: Sample scenario, not current news. The monetary policy committee raises the repo rate by 25 basis points; banks may pass the change on to floating-rate home loan and personal loan EMIs over the following months.

title: Illustrative: central bank cuts repo rate by 50 bps to support growth
summary: Sample scenario, not current news. A rate cut can lower borrowing costs on new and floating-rate loans, while fixed deposit rates may also drift lower.

title: Illustrative: retail CPI inflation rises above the central bank's tolerance band
summary: Sample scenario, not current news. Higher food and fuel prices push consumer price inflation up; household budgets and the future cost of goals such as education may rise.

title: Illustrative: food prices ease and CPI inflation cools for a third month
summary: Sample scenario, not current news. Cooling inflation can help real returns on savings and reduce pressure on monthly household expenses.

title: Illustrative: Nifty 50 falls 4% in a week as investors sell equities
summary: Sample scenario, not current news. A broad sell-off in Indian stocks lowers the value of equity mutual funds; short-term volatility matters most for money needed soon.

title: Illustrative: Sensex reaches a record high on strong foreign investor inflows
summary: Sample scenario, not current news. A rally lifts equity portfolios; past gains do not indicate future returns and portfolios can drift away from target allocation.

title: Illustrative: US Federal Reserve holds interest rates steady, signals caution
summary: Sample scenario, not current news. Global bond yields and the dollar may react to central bank signals, which can feed into emerging-market currencies and flows.

title: Illustrative: global stocks slide as recession fears grow
summary: Sample scenario, not current news. Weaker growth expectations in major economies weigh on equity markets worldwide, including international funds.

title: Illustrative: quarterly GDP growth slows to 5.8% as consumption softens
summary: Sample scenario, not current news. Slower economic growth can affect company earnings and, over time, hiring and wage growth.

title: Illustrative: manufacturing PMI and exports strengthen the economic outlook
summary: Sample scenario, not current news. Stronger factory activity and export demand point to steadier economic growth in the coming quarters.

title: Illustrative: IT services firms announce layoffs and slow campus hiring
summary: Sample scenario, not current news. Job cuts in the technology sector can affect income stability for salaried employees in the industry.

title: Illustrative: urban unemployment rate falls in the latest labour force survey
summary: Sample scenario, not current news. A stronger job market can support household income and consumption.

title: Illustrative: semiconductor demand from AI data centres lifts technology shares
summary: Sample scenario, not current news. Tech-heavy funds may become more concentrated after a sector rally.

title: Illustrative: UPI transaction volumes hit a new monthly high as digital payments grow
summary: Sample scenario, not current news. Growth in digital payments and fintech adoption continues.

title: Illustrative: banks report rising stress in unsecured personal loans
summary: Sample scenario, not current news. Banking sector data shows higher delinquencies on credit cards and personal loans; lenders may tighten credit.

title: Illustrative: real estate sector sees housing sales slow in major cities
summary: Sample scenario, not current news. Housing demand cools as home loan costs stay elevated; realty and cement stocks may react.

title: Illustrative: markets regulator tightens rules on small-cap mutual fund disclosures
summary: Sample scenario, not current news. New regulatory guidelines require funds to publish liquidity stress-test results for investors.

title: Illustrative: budget revises income tax slabs and retirement savings deductions
summary: Sample scenario, not current news. Changes in tax rules can alter take-home pay and the value of tax-saving options such as PPF, NPS and ELSS.

title: Illustrative: banks raise fixed deposit rates for senior citizens
summary: Sample scenario, not current news. Higher deposit rates can improve returns on emergency-fund savings and short-term cash.

title: Illustrative: crude oil prices jump on supply concerns
summary: Sample scenario, not current news. Higher oil prices can feed into fuel prices and inflation in import-dependent economies and affect the rupee.

title: Illustrative: rupee weakens to a record low against the US dollar
summary: Sample scenario, not current news. A weaker currency can raise the cost of imports, foreign education and overseas travel.
